_how_to: Copy to <JURISDICTION>.json (e.g. EU.json, SG.json, AE.json), edit, then: ./securax residency enable --jurisdiction <JURISDICTION>. Zones are YOUR names: 'local' (on-prem), a country/region name for approved clouds, 'global'. A class lists the zones it may be processed in; the most sensitive class must NOT allow '*'.
